title: Stop refuses a diff that breaks an enforced standard
body:
Source: .krn/runs/brain-research/north-star.md missing item 1, moment "before Stop"
Why: `krn standards review` (src/brain/standards-review.ts) finds enforced records the diff breaks, but only a brief tells the worker to run it; a session can end with a violation the brain already knows.
Outcome: the Stop hook runs the standards review on the session diff and refuses once with the violated record ids and file:line, in every adopted repository and in KRN; a record the repo contract waives is skipped.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/brain/standards-review.ts, test/hook/stop.test.ts
Proof: Stop test with a planted violation refuses with its record id and file:line, then passes after the fix; outside rows keep drain 0.
Predicted: proof stop-refusals <= 1
